iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear file worsened modestly: Kazakhstan/IAEA stockpile custody offers and talks remain active, but US-Iran positions are described as fundamentally different and deal prospects dimmed. Declared 60 percent enrichment remains the standing technical risk; no verified higher-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: US-Iran/Gulf risk remains imminent but eased from peak: US officials and major outlets report tentative ceasefire/Hormuz-reopening arrangements, while fresh reporting also describes strikes, UAE involvement, shipping disruption, and oil-market volatility. Hormuz remains restricted rather than normalized.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon risk rose again: Reuters and other outlets report Israeli forces crossed a key Lebanon river and pushed deeper while Israeli attacks killed civilians. Talks continue, but truce-break and ground-force expansion dominate the next-24h risk.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean scan surfaced no fresh direct interstate clash, weapons demonstration, official atomic warning, or mobilization surge. Background regional alignment remains below escalation threshold.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated on IISS/twin-front military posture reporting and sharp army-chief rhetoric, but no fresh cross-border strike or new force surge surfaced in the 24h window.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO direct-confrontation risk remains driven by strategic warning/Oreshnik rhetoric plus NATO outrage after the Romania drone incident. No direct NATO-Russia kinetic exchange confirmed.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China/Taiwan remains elevated but below critical: fresh feed showed patrol warnings and background first-island-chain commentary, not a blockade, live-fire surge, or crisis-level Taiwan Strait trigger.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea risk rose: South Korea reported an unidentified projectile and multiple outlets reported North Korea firing several missiles off the west coast. No device event reported.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top escalation driver: NATO and the EU condemned Russia after a drone hit a Romanian residential block; Romania summoned Moscow and NATO repeated defense commitments. Strategic warning rhetoric remains active.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical: reporting says Pakistan is pushing operations deeper into Afghanistan and Taliban sources report Pakistani air strikes causing casualties. Russia-related diplomatic channels exist but do not offset current force-use risk.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudan/Red Sea spillover eased slightly because fresh scan surfaced sparse new hard-conflict evidence beyond Horn of Africa geopolitical rivalry. External-backing and force-posture risks remain active, but no fresh major infrastructure-hit signal was confirmed.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk remains imminent: reporting says Netanyahu is seeking expanded control of Gaza, Israeli strikes continued, and UN-linked warnings say the occupation plan will deepen civilian suffering. The political off-ramp remains weak.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei scan found no fresh clash trigger; residual instability remains elevated due to transitional fragility, but not critical in the current window.
